description: This source file defines an immutable Java class ImmutableEnforcement that implements the Enforcement interface. It models enforcement rules with an input string and a set of filters, providing methods to create instances, serialize to JSON, and deserialize from JSON.

classes.name: ImmutableEnforcement
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the Enforcement interface, providing JSON serialization/deserialization and encapsulating enforcement rules.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableEnforcement instance with specified input string and filters.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the input string that is matched against filters.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns the set of filters associated with the enforcement.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the enforcement object to a JSON representation based on the specified schema version and predicate.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an Enforcement object from a JSON representation.
